title: Postgres overview
description: Managed Postgres, FerretDB and Babelfish services: CloudNativePG metrics from the resource group Alloy, pod and volume usage from the team collector, and the utilization the provider reports to Codesphere.

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.definition:
SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, if(argMaxIf(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'], TimeUnix, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'] != '') AS service_name != '', concat(service_name, ' (', service, ')'), service)
FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'cnpg_collector_up' AND service != ''
GROUP BY service ORDER BY service_name, service

panels.title: Status

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  up.service AS Service,
  names.v AS Name,
  up.v AS Up,
  up.pods AS Instances,
  version.v AS Version,
  conn.v AS Connections,
  maxconn.v AS `Max connections`,
  size.v AS `Database size`,
  lag.v AS `Replication lag`,
  errors.v AS `Exporter errors`
FROM (SELECT service, max(if(last > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE, v, 0)) AS v, countIf(last > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AS pods FROM (SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v, max(TimeUnix) AS last
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'cnpg_collector_up'
  GROUP BY service, series) GROUP BY service) AS up
LEFT JOIN (SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, argMax(Attributes['full'], TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND MetricName = 'cnpg_collector_postgres_version'
  GROUP BY service) AS version USING service
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, sum(v) AS v FROM (SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND MetricName = 'cnpg_backends_total'
  GROUP BY service, series) GROUP BY service) AS conn USING service
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, max(v) AS v FROM (SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_settings_setting' AND Attributes['name'] = 'max_connections'
  GROUP BY service, series) GROUP BY service) AS maxconn USING service
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, sum(v) AS v FROM (SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_database_size_bytes' AND Attributes['datname'] NOT IN ('template0', 'template1')
  GROUP BY service, series) GROUP BY service) AS size USING service
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, max(v) AS v FROM (SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_replication_lag'
  GROUP BY service, series) GROUP BY service) AS lag USING service
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, max(v) AS v FROM (SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND MetricName = 'cnpg_collector_last_collection_error'
  GROUP BY service, series) GROUP BY service) AS errors USING service
LEFT JOIN (SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, argMaxIf(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'], TimeUnix, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'] != '') AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'cnpg_collector_up'
  GROUP BY service) AS names USING service
WHERE up.service IN (${service:singlequote})
ORDER BY Service
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1

panels.description: Services that reported in the time range. Up is down when no metrics arrived for 10 minutes; the other columns are the latest values of the last 10 minutes. Names come from marketplace events of the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, service, sum(v) AS value FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service_id, if(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'] != '', concat(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'], ' (', service_id, ')'), service_id) AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, avg(Value) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'cnpg_backends_total' AND service_id IN (${service:singlequote})
  GROUP BY time, service, series
) GROUP BY time, service ORDER BY time

panels.description: Connections waiting for a lock another transaction holds.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, service, max(v) AS value FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service_id, if(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'] != '', concat(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'], ' (', service_id, ')'), service_id) AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, max(Value) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'cnpg_backends_max_tx_duration_seconds' AND service_id IN (${service:singlequote})
  GROUP BY time, service, series
) GROUP BY time, service ORDER BY time

SELECT time, service, sum(greatest(v - prev, 0)) / $__interval_s AS value FROM (
  SELECT time, service, series, v, lagInFrame(v, 1, v) OVER (PARTITION BY service, series ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prev
  FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service_id, if(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'] != '', concat(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'], ' (', service_id, ')'), service_id) AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, max(Value) AS v
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_stat_database_xact_commit' AND service_id IN (${service:singlequote})
    GROUP BY time, service, series
  )
) GROUP BY time, service ORDER BY time

SELECT time, service, sum(greatest(v - prev, 0)) / $__interval_s AS value FROM (
  SELECT time, service, series, v, lagInFrame(v, 1, v) OVER (PARTITION BY service, series ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prev
  FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service_id, if(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'] != '', concat(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'], ' (', service_id, ')'), service_id) AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, max(Value) AS v
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_stat_database_xact_rollback' AND service_id IN (${service:singlequote})
    GROUP BY time, service, series
  )
) GROUP BY time, service ORDER BY time

SELECT time, service, sum(greatest(v - prev, 0)) / $__interval_s AS value FROM (
  SELECT time, service, series, v, lagInFrame(v, 1, v) OVER (PARTITION BY service, series ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prev
  FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service_id, if(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'] != '', concat(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'], ' (', service_id, ')'), service_id) AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, max(Value) AS v
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_stat_database_deadlocks' AND service_id IN (${service:singlequote})
    GROUP BY time, service, series
  )
) GROUP BY time, service ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cache hit ratio

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, service, sumIf(d, kind = 'hit') / sum(d) AS value FROM (
  SELECT time, service, kind, greatest(v - lagInFrame(v, 1, v) OVER (PARTITION BY service, series, kind ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) AS d
  FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service_id, if(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'] != '', concat(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'], ' (', service_id, ')'), service_id) AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series,
      if(MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit', 'hit', 'read') AS kind, max(Value) AS v
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName IN ('cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit', 'cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_read')
      AND service_id IN (${service:singlequote})
    GROUP BY time, service, series, kind
  )
) GROUP BY time, service HAVING sum(d) > 0 ORDER BY time

panels.description: Share of block reads served from shared buffers. Low values mean the working set doesn't fit in memory.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, service, sum(v) AS value FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service_id, if(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'] != '', concat(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'], ' (', service_id, ')'), service_id) AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, avg(Value) AS v

  GROUP BY time, service, series
) GROUP BY time, service ORDER BY time

panels.title: Since last WAL archive

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, service, min(v) AS value FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service_id, if(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'] != '', concat(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'], ' (', service_id, ')'), service_id) AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, min(Value) AS v

panels.description: Grows on an idle database too; only a concern together with failing archiving.

panels.title: CPU

targets.rawSql:
WITH pods AS (
  SELECT Attributes['pod'] AS pod, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service_id, argMax(if(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'] != '', concat(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'], ' (', service_id, ')'), service_id), TimeUnix) AS service
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'cnpg_collector_up' AND service_id IN (${service:singlequote})
  GROUP BY pod, service_id
)
SELECT time, service, sum(v) AS value FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, avg(Value) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'k8s.pod.cpu.usage' AND pod IN (SELECT pod FROM pods)
  GROUP BY time, pod
) AS m JOIN pods USING pod
GROUP BY time, service ORDER BY time

panels.title: Memory

targets.rawSql:
WITH pods AS (
  SELECT Attributes['pod'] AS pod, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service_id, argMax(if(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'] != '', concat(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'], ' (', service_id, ')'), service_id), TimeUnix) AS service
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'cnpg_collector_up' AND service_id IN (${service:singlequote})
  GROUP BY pod, service_id
)
SELECT time, service, sum(v) AS value FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, avg(Value) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'k8s.pod.memory.working_set' AND pod IN (SELECT pod FROM pods)
  GROUP BY time, pod
) AS m JOIN pods USING pod
GROUP BY time, service ORDER BY time

panels.description: Kubelet stats of the rg namespace, collected by the team collector, joined to services by pod. Working set, summed over all instances.

panels.title: Disk usage

targets.rawSql:
WITH pods AS (
  SELECT Attributes['pod'] AS pod, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service_id, argMax(if(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'] != '', concat(Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'], ' (', service_id, ')'), service_id), TimeUnix) AS service
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'cnpg_collector_up' AND service_id IN (${service:singlequote})
  GROUP BY pod, service_id
)
SELECT time, concat(service, ' ', pvc) AS volume, max(used) AS value FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod,
    ResourceAttributes['k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name'] AS pvc,
    1 - avgIf(Value, MetricName = 'k8s.volume.available') / avgIf(Value, MetricName = 'k8s.volume.capacity') AS used
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName IN ('k8s.volume.available', 'k8s.volume.capacity') AND pvc != '' AND pod IN (SELECT pod FROM pods)
  GROUP BY time, pod, pvc
) AS m JOIN pods USING pod
WHERE isFinite(used)
GROUP BY time, volume ORDER BY time

panels.description: Kubelet stats of the rg namespace, collected by the team collector, joined to services by pod. Used share of each volume (data and WAL). Postgres stops when a volume is full.

panels.title: Utilization of plan

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, concat(if(Attributes['name'] != '', concat(Attributes['name'], ' (', Attributes['targetId'], ')'), Attributes['targetId']), ' ', Attributes['resource']) AS resource, max(Value) AS value
FROM otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'codesphere.managed_service.utilization.ratio' AND Attributes['targetId'] IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, resource ORDER BY time

panels.description: What the provider reports to the marketplace for each plan resource, as the marketplace exports it (codesphere.managed_service.utilization). Value divided by the plan value.

panels.title: Latest utilization

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Attributes['targetId'] AS Service, Attributes['name'] AS Name, Attributes['resource'] AS Resource,
  argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'codesphere.managed_service.utilization') AS Current,
  argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'codesphere.managed_service.utilization.ratio') AS `Of plan`,
  max(TimeUnix) AS Reported
FROM otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName IN ('codesphere.managed_service.utilization', 'codesphere.managed_service.utilization.ratio')
  AND Attributes['targetId'] IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY Service, Name, Resource ORDER BY Service, Resource

panels.description: What the provider reports to the marketplace for each plan resource, as the marketplace exports it (codesphere.managed_service.utilization). Current is in the unit of the plan parameter.
